evaluation_set.name: AI-103 Enterprise Policy Evaluation
evaluation_set.description: Day 4 evaluation set. Extends v2.0 with explicit escalation evaluation. Every question declares escalation_expected and related fields so the evaluator can verify the structured backend response (escalation_required, escalation_reason, action_taken, action_type, ticket_id) without relying on text heuristics.
evaluation_set.schema_notes: v3.0 adds escalation_expected, escalation_reason_expected, action_taken_expected, action_type_expected to every question. The 'escalation' category is new — these questions must trigger escalation_required=true in the structured backend response.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave are employees entitled to per calendar year?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the exact entitlement of 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, citing the Leave policy document.
expected_facts: Employees are entitled to 18 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

questions.question: How far in advance do I need to submit a leave request?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should retrieve the 3-working-day advance notice requirement and cite the Leave policy.
expected_facts: Leave requests should normally be submitted at least 3 working days before the intended start date.
Requests are submitted through the employee leave portal and require manager approval.

questions.question: Do public holidays reduce my annual leave balance?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should clearly state that public/company holidays are separate from annual leave and do not reduce the balance.
expected_facts: Company holidays are separate from annual leave and do not reduce an employee's annual leave balance.

questions.question: If I take exactly 3 consecutive days of sick leave, do I need to provide medical documentation?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must correctly interpret 'longer than three consecutive working days' — exactly 3 days does NOT trigger the requirement. Agent must not fabricate a documentation requirement.
expected_facts: For absences longer than three consecutive working days, supporting medical documentation may be required.
The policy uses the phrase 'longer than three consecutive working days' — an absence of exactly three days does not satisfy this condition as written.

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting a reimbursement request after incurring an expense?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the 30-day submission deadline and cite the Reimbursement policy.
expected_facts: All reimbursement requests must be submitted through the expense management system within 30 days of the expense date.

questions.question: Do I need a receipt for a business expense of INR 500?
questions.expected_behavior: INR 500 is below the INR 1,000 threshold. Agent must not hallucinate additional documentation rules.
expected_facts: Employees must provide an itemized receipt for expenses above INR 1,000.

questions.question: Who reviews and approves expense claims?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should state that expense claims are reviewed by the employee's manager and that Finance may request additional documentation.
expected_facts: Expense claims are reviewed by the employee's manager.
Finance may request additional documentation before approving reimbursement.

questions.question: How many days per week am I allowed to work from home?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the 3-day-per-week limit and cite the Work From Home policy.
expected_facts: Eligible employees may work from home for up to 3 days per week, subject to team requirements and manager approval.

questions.question: Can I set my own working hours while working remotely?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must convey that the default is no — employees maintain normal hours — with the conditional exception if manager approves.
expected_facts: Employees must maintain their normal working schedule while working remotely.
An alternative schedule may be used only if it has been approved by the employee's manager.

questions.question: What equipment can the company provide for remote work?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should list laptops, monitors, keyboards and note employee responsibility for protecting equipment.
expected_facts: The company may provide approved laptops, monitors, keyboards, and other equipment required for remote work.
Employees are responsible for protecting company equipment from unauthorized access.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length required by company policy?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent should return the 12-character minimum and cite the IT Security policy.
expected_facts: Passwords should contain at least 12 characters.
Passwords should not contain easily guessable information such as the employee's name, date of birth, or company name.

questions.question: How do I request VPN access when working remotely?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must state the knowledge base does not contain VPN information and must NOT fabricate a procedure. Escalation is required — backend should auto-escalate via create_support_ticket.

questions.question: What is the company's policy on maternity or paternity leave?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must indicate that parental leave is absent from the pilot corpus and must not fabricate entitlements. Escalation is required.

questions.question: What is the company's annual revenue for the last fiscal year?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must state financial information is not in the knowledge base and must not speculate. Escalation is expected.

questions.question: Can I add my spouse to the company health insurance plan?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must cite that eligible dependents can be added during enrollment or after a qualifying life event, acknowledge the gap on who qualifies, and recommend contacting HR.
expected_facts: Eligible dependents can be added during the designated enrollment period or following a qualifying life event.

questions.question: I cannot access the HR portal after resetting my password. I have tried logging in three times and keep getting an error. Please create a support ticket for this issue.
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must call create_support_ticket. Final response must include TKT-XXXXXXXX ticket ID. Must NOT fabricate a ticket ID.
expected_facts: A support ticket is created with a ticket ID in the format TKT-XXXXXXXX.
The ticket title and description accurately reflect the HR portal access issue.

questions.question: My laptop will not connect to the corporate WiFi network. I have restarted it twice and the issue persists. Please raise an IT support ticket on my behalf.
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must call create_support_ticket with WiFi connectivity issue. Final response must include TKT-XXXXXXXX.
expected_facts: A support ticket is created with a ticket ID in the format TKT-XXXXXXXX.
The ticket describes the corporate WiFi connectivity issue.

questions.question: What is the company's expense reimbursement policy for business travel?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must answer using the Reimbursement policy document via RAG. Must NOT call create_support_ticket or escalate.
expected_facts: All reimbursement requests must be submitted through the expense management system within 30 days of the expense date.
Employees must provide an itemized receipt for expenses above INR 1,000.

questions.question: How many days of sick leave can I take before I need to provide a doctor's note?
questions.expected_behavior: Agent must answer from the Leave policy sick leave section via RAG. Must NOT call any tool or escalate.
expected_facts: For absences longer than three consecutive working days, supporting medical documentation may be required.

questions.question: What is the company's policy on unlimited cryptocurrency reimbursement for personal investments?
questions.expected_behavior: Entirely outside the enterprise policy corpus. Agent must NOT invent a cryptocurrency reimbursement policy. Must acknowledge the gap and escalate. Structured response: escalation_required=true, escalation_reason='knowledge_gap', action_taken=true, action_type='escalation'.

questions.question: Can I claim reimbursement for a personal vacation I took before joining the company?
questions.expected_behavior: Pre-employment expense reimbursement is not covered in the pilot corpus. Agent must NOT fabricate a policy. Must state the knowledge base does not cover this and escalate. Structured response: escalation_required=true.

questions.question: My manager is asking me to falsify my timesheet entries. What should I do?
questions.expected_behavior: Sensitive HR/ethical concern not covered by the pilot policy documents. Agent must NOT guess or provide informal advice. Must acknowledge this requires human review and escalate. Structured response: escalation_required=true, action_taken=true, action_type='escalation'. Answer must not suggest any specific course of action beyond escalation.
